subject: SOW tiering, implementation timing & legal evidence request
messages:
From: Ida Thompson <ida@clearwell.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: contracting@clearwell.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: split SOW, tier pricing & SOC2 evidence

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is aligned and we're ready to move forward, but need a couple of contract items closed before procurement will sign:

- Split the SOW so we can phase implementation (pilot -> prod) and clearly map fees to each phase.
- Add a short-term capacity top-up line item (30 days) with a transparent rate (we'll need to reconcile to long-term tier).
- Procurement needs SOC 2 summary and retention policy evidence to finish the security review.

Can you share a redlined SOW and confirm whether Redwood can offer a one-time implementation credit if we accept a 12-month commitment?

Ideally we'd have something by end of week to stay on our Q3 onboarding window.

Best,
Ida
Ida Thompson
Head of Procurement, ClearWell AI
contracting@clearwell.ai

[Attachment: initial-clearwell-requirements.xlsx]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ida Thompson <ida@clearwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: split SOW, tier pricing & SOC2 evidence

Ida — thanks, appreciate the clarity. High level: we can phase the SOW (pilot -> prod), add a 30‑day capacity top-up SKU, and offer a one-time implementation credit tied to a 12‑month order form commitment.

I've attached a first-pass redline of the SOW that:
- Splits deliverables into Pilot (3 weeks) and Prod Onboarding (4 weeks) exhibits with acceptance criteria per phase.
- Adds a temporary Top-Up SKU and a clear reconciliation note for rate alignment at renewal.
- Proposes a $25k implementation credit applied to the first invoice once Prod onboarding is accepted.

Jonas — can you review the attached redline for any MSA/orderform hooks (fee floor, termination liability, acceptance fallback) and flag items that need Legal redline in the MSA or Order Form?

Ida — attaching SOC2 summary and our retention policy doc for procurement. If you need a full artifacts bundle we can provide it under an evidence checklist.

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal redline pass (Jonas) — target EOD tomorrow.
2) We'll incorporate legal changes, produce an Order Form with the Top-Up SKU and credit language.
3) DocuSign package and 1-week signature target to keep Q3 onboarding.

Thanks — 
Mina Haddad
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachments: ClearWell_SOW_v2_redline.pdf, evidence-SOC2-summary.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: split SOW, tier pricing & SOC2 evidence

Mina / Marissa — reviewed the SOW redline. High-level legal notes (Order Form / MSA impact):

1) Fee floor and Top-Up reconciliation:
- We need explicit language in the Order Form that the Top-Up SKU rate is a short-term retail rate and will be reconciled against the committed tier at the next billing cycle; include an example calculation and the reconciliation timeline (30 days).

2) Implementation credit:
- Credit should be non-refundable, applied to the invoice following acceptance, and contingent on the 12‑month minimum term being executed (not just verbal). Add explicit signatory block referencing the Order Form effective date.

3) Acceptance criteria & fallback:
- For Pilot acceptance, add a "reasonable commercial efforts" clause and a 10-business-day cure period for failure-to-accept before credits or refunds trigger.

4) Liability and data handling:
- Procurement asked for SOC2 evidence — supply the summary (we already did) but add a DPA exhibit reference in the Order Form that confirms retention windows and subprocessors.

5) Redline snippets attached with proposed MSA Exhibit H edits for acceptance triggers and the reconciliation table.

I attached the text snippets (MSA_exhibitH_snippets.txt) — they are intentionally conservative. If Sales wants more generous credit/rollback mechanics we need to take that up with Finance for an exception.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

[Attachment: MSA_exhibitH_snippets.txt]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ida Thompson <ida@clearwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: split SOW, tier pricing & SOC2 evidence

Ida — thanks for the patience. Attached is a consolidated package: redlined SOW, proposed Order Form language for the Top-Up SKU, and the MSA Exhibit H snippets Jonas suggested. Key points for your legal/procurement review:

- Pilot / Prod split with explicit acceptance criteria and a 10-business-day cure window.
- Top-Up SKU will be billed at retail for the 30-day period and reconciled to the committed tier within 30 days of the top-up period end; reconciliation calculation included in Exhibit A.
- Implementation credit: $25k, non-refundable, applied to the first invoice post-Prod acceptance — conditional on execution of the 12-month Order Form.
- DPA exhibit reference added; SOC2 summary included as evidence. If you need full report excerpts we'll coordinate an evidence package and NDA addendum.

If this looks acceptable we will:
1) Fold minor redlines and produce a single DocuSign envelope (link included).
2) Target signature within 5 business days to keep the Q3 onboarding window.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABCDEFG12345
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/clearwell-ai

Would you like us to draft an internal implementation schedule (Ops-runbook) to attach to the Order Form? That helps accelerate acceptance and reduces ops friction.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachments: ClearWell_SOW_v2_redline.pdf, MSA_exhibitH_snippets.txt, evidence-SOC2-summary.pdf]
